item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Les Etoiles - Sina de Ciganos (1984) - FLAC
item.description:
Hi there!

Guys, i'm looking for FLAC files of this album by Les Etoiles, a queer brazilian duo, called "Sina de Ciganos" from 1984.
I'm working as sound opperator of a theatrical play called "ANGU" where we tell stories of gay men against sexism and homophobia and honor Les Etoiles and other brazilian gay personalities. We have a lipsynch scene at the end with a song from that album called "Voltei" but the sound quality of the file i own is awful.

Can anyone with a physicla copy of the disc help me with this request? Please!

Thanks in advance, babies <3
